t: highlight highlight.js Language Grammar livescript.js hljs.highlight redos
d: A flaw has been found in highlight highlight.js up to 11.12.0. The affected element is the function hljs.highlight of the file src/languages/livescript.js of the component Language Grammar Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument text can lead to inefficient regular expression complexity. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

t: OceanWP before 4.2.9 Stored XSS via EDD Category Name
d: OceanWP WordPress Theme before 4.2.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the oceanwp_edd_terms_list() function in inc/edd/edd-helpers.php, which allows authenticated users with EDD download category creation permissions to inject malicious JavaScript by crafting a category name that breaks out of an unescaped HTML title attribute. Attackers can create a category name containing an event-handler payload that executes in the browser of visitors who interact with the category link on the public EDD archive page, potentially compromising an administrator's session if they view the affected page while authenticated.

A vulnerability has been found in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.6. The affected element is the function RNNLanguageModel.load_language_model of the file hanlp/layers/embeddings/contextual_string_embedding.py. Such manipulation of the argument model_file leads to deserialization. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.1.7 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is 6962907e37dfa467fa6dee164b5b1d0a904b24db. The affected component should be upgraded.

t: hankcs HanLP TAR Archive Extraction io_util.py uncompress path traversal
d: A flaw has been found in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.6. Impacted is the function uncompress of the file hanlp/utils/io_util.py of the component TAR Archive Extraction Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.1.7 is recommended to address this issue. Patch name: feb0f82d12762cf4e687b9926efd90c672857780. You should upgrade the affected component.

t: continuedev continue Config Resolution LocalPlatformClient.ts LocalPlatformClient.resolveFQSNs information disclosure
d: A vulnerability has been found in continuedev continue up to 2.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function LocalPlatformClient.resolveFQSNs of the file core/config/yaml/LocalPlatformClient.ts of the component Config Resolution. Such manipulation of the argument Name leads to information disclosure. Local access is required to approach this attack. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
